commands.summary: Plan and execute the typed remove email hard bounce write action.
commands.risk: clears an email address's hard-bounced status, allowing future sends to resume; use only after confirming the underlying delivery issue is actually resolved, or the address will likely hard-bounce again and harm sender reputation
commands.approval: reverse ETL writes require plan, preview, approval, execute
examples: pm braze remove email hard bounce apply --json
commands.notes: Pinned source operation braze.rest.post.EmailBounceRemove26; writes.json action remove_email_hard_bounce is the declared method/path/body execution component.

commands.summary: Plan and execute the typed remove email spam write action.
commands.risk: clears an email address's spam-complaint status, allowing future sends to resume; reversing a genuine spam complaint risks another complaint and further sender-reputation damage
commands.approval: reverse ETL writes require plan, preview, approval, execute
examples: pm braze remove email spam apply --json
commands.notes: Pinned source operation braze.rest.post.EmailSpamRemove28; writes.json action remove_email_spam is the declared method/path/body execution component.
